title: Placement Department Infrastructure
content:
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces"][vc_column][vc_single_image image="25105" img_size="full"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="CAREER GUIDANCE & PLACEMENT CELL INFRASTRUCTURE"]

ATME College of Engineering has a state-of-the-art infrastructure for its Career Guidance & Placement Cell. The infrastructure includes various facilities such as group discussion rooms of varying capacities, interview rooms, seminar hall, and many more.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="50px"][vc_column_text]

DISCUSSION ROOM

The group discussion rooms are designed to accommodate different group sizes, ranging from small groups to larger groups. These rooms are equipped with the latest audio-visual technology, which enables students to conduct effective group discussions and debates. The rooms are also designed to provide a comfortable and conducive environment for students to engage in meaningful discussions.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="50px"][vc_column_text]INTERVIEW ROOM

The interview rooms are equipped with modern amenities and are designed to provide a professional and comfortable setting for students to attend job interviews. These rooms are equipped with high-quality audio-visual technology, which enables students to communicate effectively with potential employers. The interview rooms are also designed to provide students with a comfortable and stress-free environment, which enables them to perform at their best during interviews.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="50px"][vc_column_text]

SEMINAR HALL

Seminar hall is a spacious and well-equipped facility that is designed to accommodate large gatherings. This facility is used for conducting seminars, workshops, and other training programs related to career guidance and placement. The seminar hall is equipped with modern audio-visual technology, which enables trainers to deliver interactive and engaging training sessions.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="50px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height="50px"][vc_column_text]RECEPTION

In addition to these facilities, the Career Guidance & Placement Cell at ATME College of Engineering also has a computer lab, a library, and other resources that are designed to support students in their career development. The computer lab is equipped with the latest software and hardware, which enables students to acquire technical skills that are in demand in the job market. The library is stocked with books, journals, and other resources related to career guidance and placement, which enables students to stay updated with the latest trends and developments in their respective fields.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text]

In essence, the infrastructure of the Career Guidance & Placement Cell at ATME College of Engineering is designed to provide students with a comprehensive and conducive environment for their career development. With these facilities, students are well-equipped to face the challenges of the job market and achieve their career goals.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
